## SQL
```sql
WITH owner AS (SELECT old_company_id AS id, new_company_id AS to_id FROM merges),
seen AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(o.to_id, u.company_id) AS company, date(datetime(u.login_at, '+8 hours')) AS d
  FROM users u LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.id = u.company_id
),
active AS (
  SELECT company FROM seen WHERE d BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY company HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d) >= 3
),
paid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(o.to_id, s.company_id) AS company
  FROM subscriptions s LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.id = s.company_id
  WHERE s.end_date >= s.start_date AND s.is_trial = 0
    AND s.start_date <= '2026-09-30' AND s.end_date >= '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active WHERE company IN (SELECT company FROM paid);
```

## 结果
31

## 口径说明
活跃指 9 月（北京时间，login_at 由 UTC 加 8 小时）至少 3 个不同自然日有登录，付费指 9 月 30 日有生效中的正式订阅（不含试用，剔除结束日早于开始日的订阅），按企业去重并按合并记录归到新 ID。
